邊界修改與下載 / Alterations and data access

中國與台灣保持獨立的編輯範圍。中國幾何會減去台灣國家／縣市邊界；合併操作會用 polygon union/difference 產生上一層剩餘範圍。邊界可經 geoBoundaries 簡化，父子區域部分以代表點推算。China/Taiwan editing roots are separate; CHN geometries exclude the Taiwan country/county protection union. Partial merges use polygon union/difference. Simplification and representative-point parent inference may also apply.

機器可讀修改方法 / Machine-readable alteration methods · 內附資料與 SHA-256 / Bundled data manifest and hashes · 隔離算法 / Isolation algorithm · 合併算法 / Merge algorithm

在地圖來源視窗可以下載目前顯示的全部邊界 GeoJSON 與來源清單，包含原始授權及修改資訊，不含顏色、圖示或自訂圖例說明。基於 ODbL 資料所產生、由本專案持有的衍生資料庫權利按 ODbL 1.0 提供；原始資料的授權不被取代，其他程式碼的權利另計。The map dialog offers current boundary geometry and provenance downloads without fill colors, symbols or authored legend descriptions. Derivative database rights held by this project and based on ODbL inputs are offered under ODbL 1.0; underlying licenses and unrelated software rights remain applicable.

支援的資料授權 / Supported data licenses

ODbL 1.0 · PDDL 1.0 · CC BY 4.0 · CC0 1.0 · Etalab 2.0 · dl-de/by-2-0 · Public Domain。

授權辨識依提供者的 metadata；未知或缺漏的授權先標示待確認。這是技術上的載入規則，無法驗證每個提供者的所有權利鏈或取代專業法律意見。The license gate uses provider metadata; it does not independently verify every upstream chain of rights or replace legal review.

儲存與隱私 / Storage & privacy

著色、圖示、圖例與語言偏好保存在你的瀏覽器 localStorage；匯出檔案由瀏覽器產生。本站沒有自行加入分析追蹤或傳送地圖存檔的後端。字型使用系統字型，Leaflet 與幾何程式庫隨網站附帶。按需查詢行政區時，瀏覽器會連線 geoBoundaries 與 GitHub 的資料服務，服務提供者會接收到一般網路請求資訊，例如 IP 與所請求的國家／層級；主機平台也可能有其服務日誌。訪問外部來源／授權連結時適用該服務的隱私政策。

Map markings and language preferences stay in browser localStorage. Exports are generated locally. This application adds no analytics or backend that receives map saves. Fonts are system fonts; Leaflet and geometry code are bundled. On-demand boundary requests contact geoBoundaries and GitHub, which receive normal request information such as IP address and requested country/level. The hosting provider may maintain service logs. External links are governed by their respective privacy policies.
